I can't give you an amount or a combination for pre-workouts or any supplement, so I won't say whether two at once is safe. Those products contain stimulants like caffeine, and how much is right depends on your health and what's in each one. Check the label, then ask a doctor or pharmacist before you stack them.

Meanwhile, if you're after more energy in the gym, I can look at your sleep and recovery with you, or adjust the training itself. What are you working on this week?
